newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber quiet, China making inquiries.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber quiet, China making inquiries.

text.p: Trading in the Singapore rubber market was quiet by midsession on Monday with Chinese buyers said making inquiries in the market, dealers said.
"It's a quiet, morning market. But I heard the Chinese are making inquiries in the market although I have not heard of any deals done yet," a trader said.
The Chinese were said to be making inquiries for RSS3 rubber, the dealers said.
The market was also looking for leads from the Japanese market in the afternoon session.
"The market is looking for some direction. We'll see how the trading goes in the afternoon," another dealer said.
At around 0445 GMT, September RSS3 was indicated at 89.00-90.00 U.S. cents a kg from 89.25 cents.
September RSS1 was indicated at 132.50 Singapore cents (92 U.S. cents) a kg from the previous 133.25 cents.
September TSR20 was indicated at 130.00-132.00 Singapore cents (90-92 U.S. cents) a kg from 131.00 cents.
